title: Metal Pless PLBH 0836-16: eight feet in the box, sixteen feet extended
summary: An 8 ft box, 16 ft expanded width and hydraulic wings: keep the exact PlowMaxx model, carrier application and cutting-edge specification together before an installation enquiry.

sections.heading: Eight feet in the box, sixteen feet extended
sections.text: The Metal Pless PlowMaxx PLBH 0836-16 combines an eight-foot box width with a sixteen-foot extended blade. Two four-foot hydraulic wings let the operator change the working configuration instead of committing every pass to one fixed shape.

sections.heading: Confirm the ordered configuration
sections.text: The manufacturer lists a 36-inch blade height, an approximate 2,435-pound attachment weight and a 12,001–18,000-pound carrier application. Its available cutting-edge configurations include LiveEdge, alongside other options. Confirm the exact ordered edge; the model family alone does not establish what is fitted.

sections.heading: Match the equipment, not a photograph
sections.text: This is an equipment-matching story as much as a width story. Metal Pless lists PlowMaxx for wheel loaders, skid steers and backhoes. A photograph of a similar plow on a tractor or truck does not establish compatibility with this model. Ask the supplier to verify the carrier, mounting interface, hydraulic requirements and operating limits before arranging installation.

sections.heading: Put the route into the conversation
sections.text: For contractors moving between confined areas and open parking lots, adjustable wings offer an operational question worth testing: which configuration best suits each part of the route? Evaluate the complete machine and attachment together, including transport and storage arrangements.
